e.title: ILP/UVL Cashflow Illustration
e.summary: 万能寿险/投资连结产品现金流演示表（rslife 作者开源）：寿险产品演示计算的轻量工具
e.body: ILP/UVL Cashflow Illustration Spreadsheet 是 hnlearndev（rslife Rust 精算库作者）开源的寿险产品现金流演示表工具：为万能寿险（UL）与投资连结产品（ILP）做保单演示（illustration）计算——精算师日常小任务的轻量开源助手，另有完整 Rust 翻译版（Universal-Life-Investment-Link-Cashflow-Illustration-Rust）。对 RIAA：寿险产品演示计算的实现参考（演示是寿险销售与监管的核心文档）。与 [[rslife]]（Rust 寿险数学）、[[lifecontingencies-jl]]（Julia）、[[detlifeinsurance]]（寿险估值）互补。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[lifeinsurer]]。
e.verified_note: raw README 核实：hnlearndev（rslife 作者）UL/ILP 现金流演示表开源工具，含 Rust 翻译版
e.summary_en: Universal-life/investment-linked product cashflow illustration spreadsheet (open source by the rslife author): lightweight tool for life-product illustration calculations
e.summary_hk: 萬能壽險/投資連結產品現金流演示表（rslife 作者開源）：壽險產品演示計算的輕量工具
e.body_en: ILP/UVL Cashflow Illustration Spreadsheet is the open-source life-product illustration tool by hnlearndev (author of the rslife Rust actuarial library): policy illustration calculations for universal life (UL) and investment-linked products (ILP) — a lightweight open-source assistant for actuaries' small daily tasks, with a full Rust translation (Universal-Life-Investment-Link-Cashflow-Illustration-Rust). For RIAA: an implementation reference for life-product illustration calculations (illustrations are core sales/regulatory documents in life insurance). Complements [[rslife]] (Rust life math), [[lifecontingencies-jl]] (Julia) and [[detlifeinsurance]] (life valuation). Related: [[actuarial-pricing]], [[lifeinsurer]].
e.body_hk: ILP/UVL Cashflow Illustration Spreadsheet 是 hnlearndev（rslife Rust 精算庫作者）開源的壽險產品現金流演示表工具：為萬能壽險（UL）與投資連結產品（ILP）做保單演示（illustration）計算——精算師日常小任務的輕量開源助手，另有完整 Rust 翻譯版（Universal-Life-Investment-Link-Cashflow-Illustration-Rust）。對 RIAA：壽險產品演示計算的實現參考（演示是壽險銷售與監管的核心文檔）。與 [[rslife]]（Rust 壽險數學）、[[lifecontingencies-jl]]（Julia）、[[detlifeinsurance]]（壽險估值）互補。關聯 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[lifeinsurer]]。
